title: Big Eye Louis Nelson and her father's retirement
summary: Justin Adams prompts memories of clarinetist Big Eye Louis Nelson, who played with her father; Allen says Nelson died in 1949 and confirms the father retired around 50 and died at 74.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

Yes, about that.
